description: Timestamp when this vehicle build record was first created in the MES/data platform. Represents the audit trail creation event, distinct from the build_start_timestamp which is the actual shop floor event time.

description: Result of the automated end-of-line (EOL) functional test performed on the completed vehicle, covering powertrain, brakes, ADAS, and electrical systems. Distinct from quality_gate_status which covers visual/dimensional inspection.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 8.6; DOT FMVSS – Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards; SAE J1739 FMEA

description: The unique serial number of the engine unit installed in this vehicle during chassis assembly. Critical for powertrain genealogy, warranty traceability, and recall management.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 – Traceability; NHTSA Recall Regulations 49 CFR Part 573

description: Actual timestamp when the final assembly stage was completed and the vehicle was released for PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection). Null if stage not yet completed.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle entered the final assembly stage for fluids, wheels, glass, and end-of-line checks.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: Indicates whether this vehicle build is currently under a production hold (True = on hold). A hold may be triggered by a quality non-conformance, missing parts, engineering change, or safety concern. Drives MES gating to prevent further assembly until resolved.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7 – Control of Nonconforming Outputs; Apriso/Dassault MES – Hold Management

description: Coded reason for the production hold applied to this vehicle build (e.g., QUALITY_DEFECT, MISSING_PART, ECN_CHANGE, SAFETY_CONCERN). Null if hold_flag is False. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: QUALITY_DEFECT|MISSING_PART|ECN_CHANGE|SAFETY_CONCERN|SUPPLIER_DEVIATION|TOOLING_FAILURE|OTHER — promote to reference product]
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; Apriso/Dassault MES – Hold Reason Codes

description: The target regulatory market for which this vehicle is homologated and built (e.g., USA, DEU, GBR, CHN, AUS). Determines applicable safety, emissions, and labeling standards. Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes.
reference: UNECE Vehicle Regulations; NHTSA 49 CFR; Euro NCAP; CARB; DOT FMVSS

description: The automotive model year (MY) designation for the vehicle being built (e.g., 2025). Determines applicable regulatory standards, BOM revision, and homologation requirements. Distinct from the calendar year of production.
reference: NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565; SAE J1297 – Model Year Definition

description: The manufacturer's paint color code applied to this vehicle during the paint stage (e.g., G1W – Super White, 040 – Classic White). Used for paint shop scheduling, color sequencing optimization, and customer order matching.
reference: SAP PP – Configuration / Variant; Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Product Configuration

description: Actual timestamp when the paint stage was completed and the vehicle body was released to the trim/general assembly line. Null if stage not yet completed.
Actual timestamp when the vehicle body entered the paint shop for priming, painting, and clear-coat application.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; ISO 14001 – Environmental Management (paint VOC emissions)

description: Classification of the vehicle powertrain technology being assembled: ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), BEV (Battery Electric Vehicle), or FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle). Drives assembly line routing, tooling, and EPA/CARB emissions compliance tracking.
reference: EPA 40 CFR Part 86 – Emissions Standards; CARB Title 13; SAE J1715

description: Result of the end-of-line quality gate inspection for this vehicle build. 'conditional_pass' indicates the vehicle passed with minor deviations requiring dealer rectification. Drives release-to-shipping authorization.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 8.6 – Release of Products; APQP; Euro NCAP; NHTSA FMVSS

description: Number of rework operations performed on this vehicle build. A count greater than zero indicates quality issues encountered during assembly. Used for PPM (Parts Per Million) defect rate calculation and FMEA analysis.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7; SPC – Statistical Process Control; APQP

description: Indicates whether this vehicle build has been flagged for rework due to a detected defect or non-conformance (True = rework required). Distinct from hold_flag; a vehicle can be in rework while not on hold.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 8.7 – Control of Nonconforming Outputs; FMEA Process

description: The planned calendar date on which this vehicle was scheduled to be built per the production plan (MRP/MES schedule). Used to measure schedule adherence and production plan vs. actual variance.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP – Scheduled Finish Date; MRP Planning

description: Indicates whether this vehicle build is part of the official Start of Production (SOP) launch batch (True = SOP vehicle). SOP vehicles are subject to enhanced quality scrutiny and PPAP sign-off requirements.
reference: APQP – Advanced Product Quality Planning; PPAP – Production Part Approval Process; IATF 16949

description: Actual timestamp when the stamping stage was completed and the body panels were released to the body shop. Null if stage not yet completed.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle body panels entered the stamping stage. Used for stage-level cycle time analysis and production flow monitoring.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: The unique serial number of the transmission unit installed in this vehicle. Used for drivetrain genealogy, warranty claims, and component-level recall traceability.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.2 – Traceability; NHTSA Recall Regulations 49 CFR Part 573

description: Actual timestamp when the trim assembly stage was completed. Null if stage not yet completed.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: Actual timestamp when the vehicle entered the trim assembly stage for interior fitting, electrical harness installation, and dashboard assembly.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES – Stage Tracking; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this vehicle build record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, audit trails, and detecting stale records in the Silver layer.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 – Documented Information; ISO 9001 Clause 7.5

description: Internal product/model code identifying the vehicle nameplate and variant being built (e.g., F150-XLT-4WD). Maps to the PLM product structure in Siemens Teamcenter. Used for BOM resolution and build sequence planning.
reference: Siemens Teamcenter PLM – Product Structure; SAP PP – Material Master

description: The globally unique 17-character Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) assigned to this vehicle unit at body-in-white or VIN stamping stage. Conforms to ISO 3779 / NHTSA VIN standard. SSOT for vehicle-level traceability across manufacturing, sales, and after-sales domains.
reference: ISO 3779; NHTSA 49 CFR Part 565 – VIN Requirements

description: Unique surrogate identifier for each capacity plan record in the manufacturing domain. Primary key for the capacity_plan data product.

Reference to the work center identified as the capacity bottleneck constraining overall line throughput during this planning period. Used to prioritize capacity improvement investments and focus S&OP constraint management.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Bottleneck Work Center (CM21); Theory of Constraints; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Foreign key linking to sales.fleet_contract. Business justification: Large fleet contracts (government/national accounts) with high committed_volume directly trigger capacity planning decisions — headcount, shifts, capex investments. Capacity planners must reference th

Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: Capacity planning in automotive is performed per vehicle model per plant/line. Model-level capacity reports, S&OP processes, and launch readiness reviews all require linking capacity plans to the vehi

Foreign key linking to customer.customer_fleet_account. Business justification: Fleet renewal contracts (e.g., 2,000-unit rental fleet order) are primary demand signals that trigger capacity plan adjustments. Automotive capacity planners must link capacity plans to fleet accounts
Reference to the manufacturing plant for which this capacity plan is defined. Links to the manufacturing.plant master record.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Work Center / Plant; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.3

description: Reference to the specific production line (e.g., final assembly line, body shop line, paint line) within the plant for which capacity is being planned. Links to the manufacturing.work_center or production line master.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Line; Apriso/Dassault MES — Line Configuration

description: Foreign key linking to manufacturing.production_schedule. Business justification: Capacity plans are developed in response to production schedules — the planned production volumes in the schedule drive the capacity requirements analysis. This FK links the capacity plan to the sched
Date and time when the capacity plan was formally approved by the designated authority. Marks the transition from 'submitted' to 'approved' status in the S&OP governance process.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 5.3; SAP S/4HANA PP — Approval Workflow

description: Name or employee identifier of the S&OP or manufacturing leadership authority who approved this capacity plan. Required for audit trail and governance compliance under IATF 16949.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 5.3 — Organizational Roles; SAP S/4HANA PP — Approval Workflow

description: Total scheduled production hours available in the planning period after accounting for planned downtime, shift breaks, and scheduled maintenance. Used in conjunction with rated_capacity_jph to compute rated capacity in units.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Available Capacity; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Narrative description of the primary capacity constraint at the bottleneck work center (e.g., 'Paint oven cycle time limits throughput to 58 JPH', 'Robotic welding cell maintenance window reduces available hours'). Supports root cause analysis and CapEx justification.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning Notes; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Difference between planned_production_units and demonstrated_capacity_units, representing the capacity shortfall or surplus for the planning period. Positive value indicates a capacity gap requiring corrective action (overtime, additional shifts, CapEx); negative value indicates surplus capacity.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Leveling; S&OP Process; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Classification of the capacity planning methodology used. 'rough_cut' (RCCP — Rough Cut Capacity Planning) for high-level S&OP; 'detailed' for work-center-level CRP (Capacity Requirements Planning); 'constraint_based' for Theory of Constraints analysis; 'what_if' for scenario planning and CapEx evaluation.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — RCCP/CRP; APICS CPIM Body of Knowledge

description: Planned capacity utilization rate expressed as a percentage, calculated as (planned_production_units / rated_capacity_units) × 100. Drives S&OP decisions on overtime, additional shifts, and capital investment. Target thresholds are typically 85–95% for automotive assembly.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Utilization; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1; S&OP Best Practice

description: Estimated capital expenditure amount required to address the capacity gap identified in this plan. Expressed in the plant's operating currency. Used for CapEx budget submissions and investment approval processes.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Investment Management; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Indicates whether this capacity plan identifies a requirement for capital investment (CapEx) to close a capacity gap (e.g., new tooling, additional robots, facility expansion). Triggers CapEx approval workflow in SAP FI/CO.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — CapEx Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Hours allocated for model changeovers, tooling changes, and line reconfigurations during the planning period. Relevant for mixed-model assembly lines producing multiple vehicle variants (e.g., ICE and BEV on the same line).
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Setup Time; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: Date and time when this capacity plan record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for data lineage and compliance purposes.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary values in this capacity plan record (e.g., USD, EUR, MXN, CNY). Ensures consistent financial reporting across multi-plant, multi-currency manufacturing operations.
reference: ISO 4217 — Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI — Currency Configuration

description: Planned number of vehicles to be produced per working day during the planning period, derived from planned_production_units / working_days. Used for daily MES scheduling and shift-level production targets.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Daily Production Target; Apriso/Dassault MES

description: Actual production output achieved in a comparable prior period, used as the realistic baseline for capacity planning. Reflects real-world constraints such as quality losses, minor stoppages, and changeovers. Key input to APQP (Advanced Product Quality Planning) capacity studies.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 8.4.1 — PPAP Capacity Study; APQP Reference Manual

description: Planned End of Production (EOP) date for the vehicle model or program covered by this capacity plan. Marks the milestone when production of the model is scheduled to cease. Used for capacity wind-down planning and asset redeployment decisions.
reference: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Program Milestones; APQP Reference Manual; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

description: Fiscal year (FY) to which this capacity plan belongs, used for CapEx (Capital Expenditure) alignment, budget planning, and financial reporting. Format: FY followed by 4-digit year (e.g., FY2025).
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO — Fiscal Year; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Total direct labor headcount required to execute the planned production volume during the planning period. Used for workforce planning, hiring decisions, and labor cost budgeting in SuccessFactors and SAP CO.
reference: SuccessFactors — Workforce Planning; SAP S/4HANA CO — Labor Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 7.1.2

description: Indicates whether the capacity plan is constrained by a bottleneck work center that limits overall line throughput below the planned production target. When True, the bottleneck_work_center_id and bottleneck_constraint_description fields are populated.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Bottleneck Scheduling; Theory of Constraints; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Automotive model year (MY) for which this capacity plan is prepared. Capacity plans are typically aligned to MY production programs, SOP (Start of Production), and EOP (End of Production) milestones.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Program; NHTSA MY Designation

description: Number of production shifts planned per working day for this capacity plan (e.g., 1, 2, or 3 shifts). Directly determines available production hours and total capacity for the planning period.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Shift Model; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Last calendar date of the planning period covered by this capacity plan record. Together with plan_start_date, defines the planning window for capacity supply and demand balancing.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning; ISO 8601 Date Standard

description: Externally-known, human-readable business identifier for the capacity plan record, used in S&OP (Sales and Operations Planning) communications, SAP PP capacity planning transactions (CM01/CM21), and cross-functional reporting. Format: CP-{PLANT}-{YEAR}-{MONTH}-{SEQ}.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning (CM01); IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: First calendar date of the planning period covered by this capacity plan record. Used to align capacity supply with demand signals from S&OP and MRP (Material Requirements Planning) runs.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning; ISO 8601 Date Standard

description: Current lifecycle state of the capacity plan record. 'draft' indicates work-in-progress; 'submitted' indicates pending approval; 'approved' indicates sign-off by S&OP leadership; 'active' indicates the operative plan driving production scheduling; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a newer version; 'archived' indicates historical record.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 6.1; SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning

description: Version identifier of the capacity plan, enabling management of multiple planning iterations (e.g., v1.0, v2.0) within the same planning period. Supports S&OP cycle versioning and plan-over-plan variance analysis.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Total planned downtime hours for the production line during the planning period, including scheduled maintenance, tooling changeovers, model changeovers, and planned shutdowns. Reduces available production hours from the theoretical maximum.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM — Maintenance Planning; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: Subset of planned downtime hours specifically allocated to preventive and predictive maintenance activities on production equipment. Tracked separately from changeover downtime for maintenance KPI reporting and SAP PM integration.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM — Preventive Maintenance; IATF 16949 Clause 8.5.1

description: Total overtime hours planned for the production line during the planning period to meet production targets beyond standard shift capacity. Feeds into workforce cost planning and labor budget in SAP CO.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP/CO — Capacity Planning; SuccessFactors Workforce Planning

description: Number of vehicles planned for production in the planning period as agreed in the S&OP process. Represents the demand signal that capacity must satisfy. Compared against rated and demonstrated capacity to identify gaps.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Program; S&OP Process

description: Granularity of the capacity planning horizon for this record. 'weekly' supports short-term MES scheduling; 'monthly' supports S&OP cycles; 'quarterly' and 'annual' support CapEx and strategic workforce planning.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning Horizon; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Demand scenario underpinning this capacity plan. 'base' reflects the consensus S&OP forecast; 'optimistic' reflects upside demand; 'pessimistic' reflects downside risk; 'stretch' reflects maximum achievable output. Enables scenario comparison for executive decision-making.
reference: S&OP Best Practice; SAP S/4HANA PP — Planning Scenario

description: Powertrain technology type planned for production in this capacity plan. ICE = Internal Combustion Engine; HEV = Hybrid Electric Vehicle; PHEV = Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle; BEV = Battery Electric Vehicle; FCEV = Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle. Impacts tooling, line configuration, and capacity requirements.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Production Program; EPA Emissions Standards; CAFE Regulations

description: Theoretical maximum production rate expressed in Jobs Per Hour (JPH) for the production line under ideal conditions. Derived from takt time and line design specifications. Used as the baseline for capacity utilization calculations in S&OP.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Definition; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1; SAE J3061

description: Theoretical maximum number of vehicles that can be produced in the planning period, calculated as rated_capacity_jph × available_hours. Represents the upper bound of production capacity for S&OP and CapEx planning.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning (CM01); IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Source system identifier for this capacity plan record in SAP S/4HANA PP (Production Planning) module, used for data lineage traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational ERP system.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Capacity Planning (CM01/CM21); Data Lineage Best Practice

description: Planned Start of Production (SOP) date for the vehicle model or program covered by this capacity plan. Marks the milestone when full-rate production is scheduled to begin. Critical for capacity ramp-up planning and APQP milestone tracking.
reference: Siemens Teamcenter PLM — Program Milestones; APQP Reference Manual; IATF 16949 Clause 8.1

description: Planned takt time in seconds for the production line during this planning period, representing the rate at which vehicles must be produced to meet customer demand. Takt time = available production time / planned production units. Core metric in JIS (Just-in-Sequence) and line balancing.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Work Center Takt Time; Apriso/Dassault MES; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Date and time when this capacity plan record was last modified. Tracks plan revisions through the S&OP cycle and supports change management auditing.
reference: IATF 16949 Clause 7.5 — Documented Information; ISO 8601 Timestamp Standard

description: Number of scheduled working days in the planning period after excluding weekends, public holidays, and planned plant shutdowns. Used to compute daily production targets and available hours.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP — Factory Calendar; IATF 16949 Clause 6.1

description: Unique surrogate identifier for each manufacturing plant or assembly facility. Primary key for the plant master record, referenced across MES, SAP PP, and logistics domains.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master

description: Primary street address of the plant facility. Used for logistics, regulatory filings, and official correspondence. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.
reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Plant Address; NHTSA Facility Registration

description: Secondary address line for the plant facility (e.g., building number, gate, or suite). Supplements address_line1 for complete facility location identification.
reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Plant Address

description: Indicates whether the plant is equipped with Automated Guided Vehicle (AGV) systems for material transport on the shop floor. Used for automation capability classification and MES integration configuration.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES - AGV Integration; SAE International Automation Standards

description: Maximum number of vehicles or assemblies the plant is designed to produce per year under normal two-shift operations. Used for capacity planning, CapEx justification, and production scheduling in SAP PP.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Capacity Planning; IATF 16949

description: City or municipality where the plant is physically located. Used for logistics planning, workforce commute analysis, and regulatory jurisdiction determination.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master

description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the plant within SAP S/4HANA and MES systems (e.g., 'DETF01', 'USNA02'). Used as the business key across ERP, MES, and logistics integrations. Maps to SAP Organizational Unit - Plant Code.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master; IATF 16949

description: The date on which the plant was officially commissioned and handed over for production operations. Distinct from SOP date; represents the physical readiness milestone. Used for asset lifecycle management and depreciation calculations in SAP AM.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM Module - Functional Location; ISO 14001

description: SAP S/4HANA company code to which this plant is assigned for financial accounting and controlling purposes. Links plant operations to the FI/CO module for cost center allocation and EBITDA reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA FI/CO Module - Company Code

description: SAP Controlling (CO) cost center code assigned to the plant for financial cost allocation, CapEx tracking, and R&D expenditure reporting. Used in management accounting and EBITDA analysis.
reference: SAP S/4HANA CO Module - Cost Center Accounting

description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code indicating the country where the plant is physically located (e.g., 'USA', 'DEU', 'CHN'). Used for regulatory compliance, CAFE reporting, and logistics routing.
reference: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; EPA CAFE Reporting; UNECE Vehicle Regulations

description: Timestamp when the plant master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and record lifecycle management in the Databricks Silver Layer.

ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the local currency used in plant-level financial reporting and cost accounting (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'CNY'). Used in SAP FI/CO for cost center reporting and CapEx tracking.
reference: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

description: Maximum number of vehicles or assemblies the plant can produce per day (Jobs Per Day - JPD). Derived from takt time and shift configuration. Used for daily production scheduling and MES throughput planning.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES - Capacity Configuration; SAP S/4HANA PP

description: The official End of Production (EOP) date when the plant is scheduled to cease production of the current model or permanently close. Used for capacity planning, workforce transition, and asset disposal planning.
reference: IATF 16949 - APQP; SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master

description: EPA-assigned facility identifier for emissions and environmental compliance reporting. Required for CAFE (Corporate Average Fuel Economy) reporting and Clean Air Act compliance.
reference: EPA - Environmental Protection Agency; CAFE Standards; CARB Regulations

description: Total manufacturing floor area of the plant in square meters. Used for facility planning, CapEx allocation, insurance valuation, and ISO 14001 environmental footprint reporting.
reference: ISO 14001 Environmental Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module - Functional Location

description: Indicates whether the plant holds a current IATF 16949 automotive quality management system certification. Mandatory for OEM supplier qualification and customer-specific requirements compliance.
reference: IATF 16949:2016 - International Automotive Task Force Quality Management

description: Indicates whether the plant holds a current ISO 14001 Environmental Management System certification. Required for EPA compliance reporting and sustainability disclosures.
reference: ISO 14001:2015 Environmental Management Systems; EPA Regulations

description: Indicates whether the plant holds a current ISO 9001 Quality Management System certification. Required for supplier qualification and regulatory compliance reporting.
Geographic latitude coordinate of the plant in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Used for geospatial analytics, logistics network optimization, and supply chain mapping.
Geographic longitude coordinate of the plant in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Used for geospatial analytics, logistics network optimization, and supply chain mapping.

Full name of the plant manager or general manager responsible for overall plant operations. Used for escalation routing, regulatory correspondence, and organizational reporting. Not classified as PII as this is a business role reference.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PM Module; SuccessFactors HR

description: The plant identifier as registered in the Apriso/Dassault MES system. Used for cross-system reconciliation between SAP PP production orders and MES shop floor execution records. Enables traceability from ERP to shop floor.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES - Plant Configuration; IATF 16949 Traceability

description: The current Model Year (MY) of vehicles being produced at the plant (e.g., '2025'). Used for production scheduling, regulatory compliance submissions, and CAFE reporting alignment.
reference: NHTSA Model Year Definition; EPA CAFE Reporting

description: Official full name of the manufacturing plant or assembly facility (e.g., 'Detroit Final Assembly Plant No. 1'). Used in reporting, regulatory submissions, and communications.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master

business_glossary_term: National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA) Facility Identifier
description: NHTSA-assigned facility identifier for the plant. Required for vehicle recall management, safety defect reporting, and Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS) compliance submissions.
reference: NHTSA - National Highway Traffic Safety Administration; DOT FMVSS

description: Total count of active production or assembly lines within the plant. Used for capacity planning, MES line configuration, and production scheduling.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES - Line Configuration; SAP S/4HANA PP

description: Number of production shifts operated per day at the plant (typically 1, 2, or 3). Drives capacity calculations, workforce planning in SuccessFactors, and MES scheduling.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Shift Planning; SuccessFactors Workforce Planning

description: Current lifecycle state of the plant. 'active' indicates full production; 'idle' indicates temporary suspension; 'ramp_up' indicates pre-SOP commissioning phase; 'ramp_down' indicates post-EOP wind-down; 'shutdown' indicates planned or unplanned stoppage; 'decommissioned' indicates permanently closed.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master; IATF 16949

description: Indicates whether the plant has the infrastructure to perform OTA (Over-the-Air) software updates on vehicles during the final assembly or PDI (Pre-Delivery Inspection) process. Relevant for connected vehicle production.
reference: Geotab/Bosch IoT - OTA Update Infrastructure; UNECE WP.29 Cybersecurity Regulation

description: Primary telephone number for the plant facility. Used for operational communications, emergency contact, and supplier/logistics coordination. Classified as confidential organizational contact data.
reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Plant Master

description: Categorical classification of the plant's primary manufacturing function. Values include stamping (metal forming), body_shop (body-in-white welding), paint (paint application), final_assembly (vehicle assembly), ckd (Completely Knocked Down assembly), skd (Semi Knocked Down assembly), powertrain (engine/transmission), logistics (parts distribution). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: stamping|body_shop|paint|final_assembly|ckd|skd|powertrain|logistics — promote to reference product]
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP Module; IATF 16949 Clause 4.1

description: Postal or ZIP code of the plant location. Used for logistics routing, tax jurisdiction assignment, and regulatory reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA MM Module - Plant Address; ISO 3166

description: Classification of powertrain technologies assembled or manufactured at this plant. ICE (Internal Combustion Engine), EV (Electric Vehicle), HEV (Hybrid Electric Vehicle), PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle), FCEV (Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle), or mixed. Used for EPA emissions compliance, CAFE reporting, and R&D investment tracking.
reference: EPA CAFE Standards; CARB ZEV Mandate; UNECE Emissions Regulations

description: The primary vehicle segment produced at this plant. Values: car (passenger cars), truck (light/heavy trucks), suv (Sport Utility Vehicles), commercial_vehicle (vans/buses/heavy commercial), ev (Battery Electric Vehicle), hev (Hybrid Electric Vehicle - HEV), phev (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle - PHEV), mixed (multiple segments). Drives model year planning and regulatory compliance requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: car|truck|suv|commercial_vehicle|ev|hev|phev|mixed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
reference: NHTSA Vehicle Classification; EPA CAFE Standards; SAE J1100

description: Geographic or operational region in which the plant is located (e.g., 'North America', 'Europe', 'Asia Pacific'). Used for regional production planning, capacity allocation, and management reporting.
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master

business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Enabled Flag
description: Indicates whether the plant operates a SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) system for real-time monitoring and control of manufacturing processes, utilities, and equipment.
reference: Apriso/Dassault MES - SCADA Integration; IEC 62443 Industrial Cybersecurity

description: Abbreviated or commonly used name for the plant used in dashboards, shop floor displays, and internal communications (e.g., 'Detroit FA1').
reference: SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master

description: The official Start of Production (SOP) date when the plant commenced or is scheduled to commence volume production. Critical milestone for capital planning, workforce ramp-up, and supplier readiness. Aligns with APQP phase-gate milestones.
reference: IATF 16949 - APQP; SAP S/4HANA PP Module - Plant Master

description: State, province, or administrative subdivision where the plant is located (e.g., 'Michigan', 'Bavaria', 'Ontario'). Used for local regulatory compliance, tax jurisdiction, and workforce reporting.
reference: DOT Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards; CARB Regulations

description: The rate at which vehicles must be produced to meet customer demand, expressed in seconds per unit. Calculated as available production time divided by customer demand rate. Fundamental to JIS (Just-in-Sequence) scheduling and line balancing in MES.
reference: SAE International - Manufacturing Engineering; Apriso/Dassault MES

description: IANA time zone identifier for the plant location (e.g., 'America/Detroit', 'Europe/Berlin'). Used for MES shift scheduling, production timestamp normalization, and cross-plant reporting in the Databricks lakehouse.

Foreign key linking to vehicle.model. Business justification: Quote line items need to reference the official MSRP schedule for the selected configuration; adding msrp_schedule_id eliminates redundant MSRP columns and enables consistent pricing lookup.

Foreign key linking to vehicle.vehicle_option_package. Business justification: Quote line for an option package should reference the canonical package entity for accurate pricing, warranty, and regulatory compliance.
Reference to the specific vehicle configuration being quoted. Applicable when line_type is vehicle. Links to the vehicle master for model, trim, and base specifications.
Foreign key reference to the parent quote header. Establishes the header-detail relationship for this line item.
Foreign key linking to inventory.sku. Business justification: Quote lines are proposals for specific SKUs; adding a foreign key to inventory.sku enables pricing and configuration consistency.
Current availability status of the line item. Indicates whether the product is in dealer inventory, allocated from manufacturer, requires build-to-order, is backordered, or has been discontinued.
Indicates whether this line item is eligible for sales representative commission. Certain line types (fees, trade-ins) may be excluded from commission calculations.
Commission rate applied to this line item for sales representative compensation. Expressed as a decimal percentage. May vary by product type and sales program.
Dealer cost or transfer price for this line item. Used for margin analysis and profitability reporting. Confidential business data not disclosed to customers.
Date and time when this quote line was first created. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone. Used for audit trail and lifecycle tracking.
Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this line. Typically inherits from quote header but may differ for international fleet quotes.
Estimated or committed delivery date for this line item. Critical for customer expectations, logistics planning, and order fulfillment tracking.
Total discount applied to this line item. Includes dealer discounts, promotional discounts, and volume discounts. Expressed as a positive value that reduces the line total.
Discount expressed as a percentage of the unit price. Used for percentage-based discount calculations and reporting. Stored alongside discount_amount for transparency.
Line item subtotal before tax. Calculated as (unit_price * quantity) - discount_amount - incentive_amount. Represents the pre-tax line total.
Manufacturer color code for the vehicle exterior paint. Used for vehicle configuration, pricing (premium colors), and inventory matching.
Total manufacturer or dealer incentive applied to this line item. Includes cash rebates, loyalty bonuses, conquest incentives, and special financing subsidies. Reduces the customer-facing price.
Human-readable description of the incentive applied. Provides customer-facing explanation of the incentive program, eligibility criteria, and value proposition.
Manufacturer color code for the vehicle interior trim and upholstery. Used for vehicle configuration, pricing, and customer preference tracking.
Sequential line item number within the quote. Determines the ordering and display sequence of line items.
Current lifecycle status of the quote line. Tracks the line through draft, approval, conversion to order, or cancellation workflows.
Total amount for this line item including tax. Calculated as extended_price + tax_amount. Represents the final customer-facing line total.

Classification of the quote line item. Distinguishes between vehicle configurations, accessories, service packages, warranties, insurance products, fees, discounts, and trade-in credits. Manufacturer Suggested Retail Price (MSRP) or standard list price for the line item before any discounts or incentives. Expressed in the quote currency.
Gross margin for this line item. Calculated as extended_price - cost_amount. Used for profitability analysis and sales performance evaluation.
Model year of the vehicle being quoted. Critical for pricing, incentive eligibility, and inventory allocation. Aligns with manufacturer production cycles.
User identifier of the person who last modified this quote line. Supports change tracking and audit requirements.
Date and time of the most recent modification to this quote line. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone. Used for change tracking and audit trail.
Free-text notes and comments specific to this line item. Used for special instructions, configuration details, customer requests, or internal coordination.
Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) or product code for accessories, service packages, warranties, or other non-vehicle line items. Links to product master for pricing and availability.
Detailed description of the line item product or service. Includes accessory names, service package details, warranty coverage terms, or fee descriptions for customer clarity.
Number of units for this line item. Typically 1 for vehicles, but may be greater than 1 for accessories, fleet orders, or service packages.
Explanation for why this line item was rejected or removed from the quote. Captures business reasons such as unavailability, pricing issues, or customer preference changes.
Total sales tax calculated for this line item. Calculated as extended_price * tax_rate. Contributes to the overall quote tax total.
Tax jurisdiction code determining the applicable sales tax rate for this line item. Links to tax master for rate lookup and tax calculation rules.
Sales tax rate applied to this line item, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0825 for 8.25%). Used for tax calculation and compliance reporting.

Actual selling price per unit after dealer adjustments but before line-level discounts and incentives. May differ from list price due to market conditions or dealer pricing strategy.
17-character Vehicle Identification Number uniquely identifying a specific vehicle unit. Populated when quoting a specific in-stock or allocated vehicle. Null for build-to-order quotes.
User identifier of the sales representative or system user who created this quote line. Used for audit trail and accountability.
